messages.author: 1c227d73568f2379
messages.subject: Truncated poisson_log distribution
parts:
Hello,

Stan provides a poisson_log distribution with the log rate as a parameter. I would need a mixture of two truncted (zero excluded) poisson_log distributions. Are there other options than taking the exp of the log rate and use the poisson_cdf_log in the increment_log_prob? Would there perhaps be a poisson_log_cdf_log comming soon?

BR,
Henrik

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Truncated poisson_log distribution
parts:
Nope --- that's not due any time soon, but we
should definitely have the CDFs for all of our
density or mass functions. So I created an issue for
this one:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1432

But there's an easy solution if you're just excluding
0, because the CDF for 0 is equal to the pmf at 0!

log CDF of 0: poisson_log_log(0, alpha)
log CCDF of 0: log1m_exp(poisson_log_log(0, alpha))

- Bob
